name: Admin Accounting Dashboard
description: Superuser opens /panel/accounting and sees the financial overview fed by GET /api/accounting/dashboard/?year=: expected vs liquid income, expenses, utilities and monthly breakdown computed from the company ledger only (personal-ledger records excluded), pocket balance, per-partner cards (Gustavo/Carlos combine company participation + personal ledger; ProjectApp (Empresa) shows the full company ledger totals), operative cost cards and latest card snapshots. The hero Utilidad líquida card embeds the full utility statistics surface as a default-open accordion with evolution, margin and partner tabs; the former 'Utilidad por mes' mini-chart, statistics icon and utility modal no longer exist. The hero grid aligns cards at their natural height to avoid blank space. The subnav orders Bolsillo second, after Resumen. The Contabilidad quick-access group replaces Ads with Cuentas de cobro linking to /panel/accounting/collections, while Ads remains in the internal accounting subnav. Includes the superuser gate: staff non-superusers are redirected to /panel and the Accounting sidebar section is hidden. Includes the Evolución section: two ApexCharts (expected vs liquid vs expenses per month, and card-debt evolution from snapshots) driven by the year selector plus a client-side month-range filter, a link to the cards history and the year persisted as a query param. Accounting charts use theme-aware foreground, legend, tooltip and center-label colors so their data remains readable in dark mode.
